tei:div.tei:p: (61)༄༅// blo sbyong rma bya dug 'joms zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

"$ (62)༄༅// btsan dug nags su rma bya rgyu ba zhes bya ba// rje btsun gshin rje'i gshed la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal bu thams cad sgrol du gyur pa na// bu dang bu mo rgyal srid byin pa ltar// shin tu phreng ba'i nor dang 'khor la sogs// phongs pa med par yongs su btang bar bya// rgyal bu snying stobs chen por gyur pa na// stag mo rang gi sha yis gsos pa ltar// shin tu gces pa'i sgyu lus phung po 'di// sha za'i tshogs la dga' bas sbyin par bya// rgyal po byams pa'i stobs su gyur pa na// gnod sbyin rang gi khrag gis gsos pa ltar// bcad par dka' ba'i snying khrag dron mo 'di// khrag 'thung dag la brtse bas sbyin par bya// tshong dpon khye'u chu 'bebs gyur pa na// bde gshegs mtshan brjod nya rnams drangs pa ltar// chos kyis phongs pa'i skye bo thams cad la// dam pa'i chos kyi sbyin pa gtong bar bya// rgyal bu dge don chen por gyur pa na// sdig don log sgrub thugs rjes bzod pa ltar// 'khor gyi log sgrub gshis ngan 'khrugs pa la// snying rje chen pos lhag par brtse bar bya// byang chub sems dpa' spre'ur gyur ba na// sdig can khron pa'i gnas nas drangs pa ltar// ngan pa dag la phan gdags mi shongs kyang*// bzang lan mi 'dod thugs (63)rjes drang bar bya// kyi hud pha mar ma gyur su yang med// 'khor ba'i gnas na bde ba skad cig med// ngan pa'i tshogs la ngan len bong ra 'dra// da ni thub chen dpa' bo'i rnam thar 'di// gus pas blangs nas gnyen po mi skyong na// dpa' bo 'jug pa'i lag len yang mi srid// de phyir srog la bsngos la dka' spyad bsten// bde bar gshegs pa 'das tshul bstan rjes su// de yi rjes su bslab par 'dod pa rnams// 'di 'dra'i lag len rgyud la ma bsten na// skye bo rnams kyi bde skyid zad dogs su// de phyir dpa' bo rnams kyi skyid chos 'di// ci la thug kyang dka' spyad srog la bsdos// 'di ni dpa' bo 'jug pa'i lag len te// le'u dang po dug gi bcud len yin// btsan dug nags su rma bya rgyu ba zhes bya ba// rje btsun gshin rje'i gshed la phyag 'tshal lo// chos 'di gson dang dpa' bo don gnyer kun// 'khor ba'i nags na rma bya mdzes pa dang*// nyon mongs dug lnga ljon pa'i shing drung du// dug gis smin pas sman la dgar mi tshol// 'dod chags lta bu'i gzhan dang ma bstun na// 'dod chags can gyis log sgrub bya dogs yod// 'dod chags lta bu'i dug 'di gzhom par bya// zhe sdang dug gi me tog 'bar ba la// gshin rje'i gshed ltar (64)khro tshul ma bstan na// zhe sdang can gyis bar chad byas dogs yod// zhe sdang lta bu'i dgra bgegs bsgral bar bya// gti mug dug gi 'dam rdzab sbyar ba la// mi ro lta bu bzod bsran ma bskyed na// gshis ngan rnams kyis sdig pa bsags dogs yod// gti mug lta bur mnyam nyid bsgom par bya// phrag dog dug gi ljon shing rgyas pa la// nga khyod lta bu'i phyi nang ma phye na// mu stegs sogs kyis bstan pa bshigs nyen yod// de phyir phrag dog lta bur dam chos skyong*// nga rgyal dug gi ljon shing 'bar ba la// nga rgyal lta bur pho tshugs ma bzung na// bdud kyi tshogs kyis mgo bskor byas nyen yod// de phyir thub bstan zungs la phas rgol gzhom// de ltar dug gi dpung tshogs ma lus pa// bden med snang stong sgyu ma lta bu'i nyams// nga bdag 'ching ba gcig tu tshur sdom la// rma bya lta bur zas su za bar bya// gzhan gyi blo la sna tshogs kun ston kyang*// phugs su gnyen pos btsan tshugs ma shor bar// dge sdig dag gi blong dor srog la bsdos// sdug bsngal gyur kyang byang chub dang du blang*// 'di ltar shes bya kun la mkhas na yang*// rang gi bde skyid khyad du ma bsad na// rnyed pa'i dbang gis chags sdang zhugs nyen yod// de phyir rang 'dod khyi rkun bzhin tu brdung*// mkhas pa rnams kyi drung du bsten gyur zhing*// gzhung lugs rnams la blo gros ma sbyongs na// mkhas pa rnams la sgro skur byas dogs yod// de phyir shes bya kun la goms par bya// nyin dang mtshan du sdug bsngal gyur na yang*// 'khor ba spyi yi nyes dmigs ma bsam na// da dung sdug bsngal rgyu la 'jug dogs yod// de phyir las kyi nyes dmigs snying la gzer// de ltar yin mod mi 'dod sdug bsngal rnams// bdag 'dzin 'joms pa'i gnyen por (65)bsten par bya// bdud dmag bye ba dung phyur dgrar langs kyang*// nga'o snyam pa'i 'jigs skrag spang bar bya// gzhan don byas pas ngan 'gror shor srid kyang*// 'gyod pa med pas nyams dga' bsten par bya// dbugs len gshed mas lus la brab gyur kyang*// bdag la phan pa'i rim gro bsten mi bya// sems can yongs kyi las ngan khur dgos kyang*// 'khur 'os 'khur bas sdug yus chung bar bya// 'go ba'i nad kyis lus la btab gyur kyang*// rang gis nongs pas log pa'i thabs mi bya// 'di ltar mi 'dod thog tu ma babs na// 'dod pa'i thabs la nam yang 'jug mi srid// mkhas pas dpyad na mi 'dod ma lus pa// 'dod rgu'i 'byung gnas yin pas dang du blangs// 'di ltar log sgrub dang du len pa yi// sems can rnams kyis go cha ma gyon na// 'khor ba pa la bde ba yong mi srid// de phyir mi 'dod dang du blang bar bya// 'di ni thub pa chen po'i rnam thar las// dam pa rnams kyis bslab par bya ba'i chos// dpa' bo rnams kyis 'jug par bya ba ste// le'u gnyis pa dug gi bcud len yin// btsan dug nags su rma bya rgyu ba zhes bya ba// rje btsun gshin rje'i gshed la phyag 'tshal lo// blo ldan gang gis nyin mtshan dus drug tu// 'khor ba spyi dang sgos kyi skyon rnams la// brtags shing dpyad pas shin tu skrag gyur nas// so sor thar ba'i sdom pa blangs te bsrung*// rang nyid thar pa'i sdom pa brtan pa na// 'gro ba 'di dag pha dang mar dpyad de// de dag don du smon 'jug sdom pa blang*// byams brtse'i sems kyis smon pa brten pa na// rang nyid 'khor ba'i nags su sdug bsngal kyang*// cir yang mi sems sdug bsngal gzhan (66)don du// srog dang bsdos nas dka' spyad brtan par bya// de tshe ma rungs skye bo mtha' yas pa// log sgrub mtha' las 'das pa myong ba na// sgyu ma rmi lam lta bur srog dang bral// rang bzhin brtags la chos kyi dbyings su bsams// de ltar bstan med snang med mngon gyur te// lhag par spobs pa bskyed de 'jigs skrag la// cir yang mi sems gang du'ang mi rtog par// gzhan don 'ba' zhig lhun gyis grub par byed// 'di 'dra'i nyams len khur du khur ba na// nag po'i phyogs kyis ches cher ma bzod nas// bar du gcod pa'i sprin phung 'khrigs pa na/

rnam dag mkha' la sngags kyi rlung gis gtor// drag po'i sngags kyi hūm̐ sgra sgrogs pa na// khro bo drag po'i nga rgyal skyes srid pas/ phung po sgyu ma'i grong khyer lta bu la// sgra ni sprul pa'i glu dbyangs lta bur shes// gang yang rang sems sna tshogs sprul pa las// ngos bzung med de sprul pa'i yid shes bzhin// ye nas yod ma myong bas rang sar klod// chos kyi dbyings gzugs bden pas grol bar bya// gang ltar ci ltar dgra dang 'drer langs kyang*// gang du'ang mi sems phyir yang mi ldog par// rang gzhan chags sdang rdog pa'i 'og tu rdzi// dran snang khro bo gshin rje'i gshed du blta// de tshe pha ma 'gro ba ma lus pa// yin nges snyam du the tshom med par bsdu// nye ring med par thugs rje'i dkyil du sba// phyogs ris med par bden pa gnyis kyis bskyang*// 'di ltar gom na thub pa'i rnam thar yin// 'di ltar bgyis na dkon mchog 'dzum pa 'chor// 'di 'dra'i mi la chos skyong ngang gis 'khor// mkhyen par mdzod cig thub pa'i sras po rnams// bdag gis khrel med chos la tho les gdab// bag med chos la bsams (67)te skyug bro bltar// 'di yang dpa' bo 'jug pa'i lag len te// le'u gsum pa dug gi bcud len yin// btsan dug nags su rma bya rgyu ba zhes bya ba// rje btsun gshin rje'i gshed la phyag 'tshal lo// nye bar 'khor ltar btsun pa'i mthar thug cing*// rta thul bzhin du bag yod mdzes gyur kyang*// byang chub lam la pha ma mi 'dren na// rang bde'i thar pa rdog pas brdzi rgyu yin// rig pa'i gnas la mkhas pa'i mthu thob cing*// snyan pa'i grags pas blun po kun dga' yang*// bstan pa'i khur chen spyi bos mi len na// smyon pa'i bro brdung bzhin du dor bya yin// bla ma lta bur kun gyis 'khur na yang*// bstan pa spyi yi khur chen mi 'khur zhing*// rang gi 'dod pa dang du len byed na// 'phags pa rnams kyis the las btab bya yin// bzang po lta bur kun gyis rloms na yang*// log lta'i nags su bdag lta 'khrugs pa yis// stag mo bu zan bzhin du 'jigs pa ste// bka' sdod srung ma rnams kyis bsgral bya yin// ngur smrig gos can zhi dul mdzes gyur kyang*// byi la bzhin du bsam pa ma rungs pa'i// dam pa'i gzugs can gso ru med pa de// ma mo rnams kyi kha ru gdab bya yin// khri phrag dgu yi gtso bor 'dug gyur kyang*// khyab 'jug bzhin du rang rgyud ma thul ba'i// chags sdang 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro ba de// gshin rje gshed kyi zhal du gdab bya yin// 'dzum zhing des pas thams cad skyod na yang*// bdag gi rjes slob zag pa 'phel byed pa// mi dang can gyi gtso bor grags pa de// gnas lug sdom pa'i 'tshang rgya spang bya yin// khyim nas byung zhing bstan pa'i sgor zhugs kyang*// khyim pa bzhin du bya ba (68)mtha' yas shing*// blang dor thams cad khyad du gsod pa de// drang srong rnams kyis dmod pas bsgrub bya yin// ngur smrig gyon nas tshul khrims mi srung zhing*// 'dod pa'i las la snang ba 'byams gyur nas// dam pa rnams la sgro skur 'debs pa de// mkha' 'gro rnams kyis pha rol bsgral bya yin// rnyed pa'i ched du dam pa'i gzugs bzung nas// khyi phag bzhin du 'dod yon spyod byed cing*// sngags su khas blangs thams cad bslu ba de// rdo rje 'dzin pas thab tu gzhug bya yin// theg chen skad du las 'bras khyad gsod cing*// stong pa'i rbad kyis 'khor tshogs bslu ba yi// 'gong po bzhin du rku ru brdzu ba de// dam tshig can gyi sngags kyis bsgral bya yin// bstan pa spyi la yong ye mi phan pa'i// sngags dang man ngag zab mor rloms pa dang*// rtog pas sbyar ba'i tshigs bcad ngan pa rnams// dam pa rnams kyis dmangs su dbab bya yin// nges par bstan pa spyi la gnod byed na// re zhig gang gis gang la phan gyur kyang*// tshad nad can la 'bras chad blud pa ltar// phan bya ngan pa chu la bskur bya yin// thos pa chung ngu'i grub thob ngan pa dag

/thun mong mthong bas mchog tu nga rgyal te// lam rim med pas blun po 'khrid pa rnams// mkhas pa rnams kyis khyi dma' dbab bya yin// sangs rgyas bstan la dgra bo longs pa na// so so'i thar la bzang por rloms gyur nas// legs par bshad pa'i 'bul mchog mi byed par// bstan pa 'jig la dam pa mtshar re che// 'di ltar so sor thar pa phar zhog gi// rang nyid ngan 'gro chen por 'gro dgos pas// bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bgegs mi sgrol re// dam nyams dgra bgegs pha rol bsgral bya yin// nyon mongs (69)las kyis bdas pa'i gti mug can// bstan dang sems can spyi la mi sems par// rang la gnod pa byas pa'i dgra bo la// khros nas sngags kyis pha rol sgrol ba de// tshul khrims 'chal lam ma 'chal mtshar re che// gang yang rgyal ba rnams kyis khrel ba yi// rang don la ni rnam pa kun mi brten// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams kyis bsngags gyur na// ji ltar gyur la de ltar sgrub par rigs// mkhyen par mdzod cig blo dang ldan pa rnams// lag len thams cad thog mtha' dag nas bya// chos dang 'gal ba srog dang bsdos la spang*// phyi la mi gnod rang la ci phan bya// blun pos rim gyis mthong bar ma gyur kyang*// mkhas pa rnams la lhang nge so sor gsal// 'di yang dpa' bo 'jug par bya ba ste// le'u bzhi pa dug gi bcud len yin// btsan dug nags su rma bya rgyu ba zhes bya ba// rje btsun gshin rje'i gshed la phyag 'tshal lo// gang la bsam pa ngan zhing sdang zhugs pa'i// nag po'i phyogs rnams ma lus drung 'dir shog /sha za khrag 'thung bye ba dung phyur rnams// lus can bdag gi drung du de ring shog /lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin tshogs rnams dang*// dri za lha ma yin dang lto phye'i tshogs// mkha' la rgyu ba'i yid btags mtha' yas dang*// lan chags 'byung po'i tshogs rnams drung 'dir shog /lhan cig skyes pa'i lha dang drang srong dang*// bgegs dang log 'dren gdon chen bco brgyad dang*// ma mo rnams dang las mgon thams cad dang*// skyabs gsum 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams gnas 'dir 'khod// de ltar ma tshang med pas 'khor bcas rnams// dpang po nyid du drung 'dir 'khod pa la// the tshom med par bdag gis dam bcas pa'i// rlabs po che yi gtam 'di (70)bshad par nyon// sngon chad rgyu rkyen bskal pa bzang po yis// deng sang 'byor pa bcu ldan lus 'di thob// ya mtshan skyes pas nyin mtshan rangs gyur nas// da ni phan bde'i dpal la cung mi spyod// smon lam dag pas khyim nas rab tu byung*// rang 'dod spangs nas smon 'jug gos su gyon// sems mchog rnyed nas gzhan don khur du 'khur// lam la zhugs nas bde mchog zas su zo// yang 'di gson dang thams cad 'dus pa'i tshogs// nag po'i phyogs kyi gdug rtsub 'di 'dra zhig

/skal med rnams kyi bsod nams 'di 'dra bas// kho bo bde ba can tu smon ma gyur// tshogs ma bsags pa'i 'byung po mtha' yas shing*// ngan song rnams kyi sdug bsngal dos drag pas// sdig spyod rnams kyi spyod pa 'di 'dra na// zhi bde gnas su kho bo dgar ma tshor// byis pa rnams kyi gnyen po bsgyur sla zhing*// bdud sde rnams kyi bsam sbyor 'di 'dra na// mi rtag tshe la sdod pa'i skabs med pas// dben pa'i gnas su 'dug la dgar ma tshor// bstan pa 'di la sdang ba'i dgra mang zhing*// btsan sar phyin pa'i grub thob 'di 'dra la// snyigs ma'i dus su snang tshul lugs ngan pas// kho bo mkha' spyod gnas su dgar ma tshor// da ni 'jig rten khams rnams thams cad kyi// mthu chen thams cad bdag gi dgrar langs kyang*// kho bo ba spu tsam yang mi g.yo bar// 'khor ba'i gnas 'dir go cha bgo bar bya// gang na 'go ba'i nad kyis thebs gyur te// rims nad chen pos 'jig rten g.yos pa na// sman pa nyid dam nad pa'i g.yog dag tu// drag po'i go cha chen po bgo bar bya// ma nus sems can drin gyis bskyab pa'i tshe// log sgrub chen pos sdug sun phyung pa na// lhag par de la phan zhing brtse ba yis// dpa' bo rnams kyis go cha bgo bar bya// nags na stag mo mi zan 'jigs pa rnams// mi yi srog la 'jab cing rgyug pa na// sems can don du the tshom mi bya bar// (71)phyogs der bgrod pa'i go cha bgo bar bya// 'jig rten dag na shin tu mi 'dod pa'i// ltas ngan sna tshogs dmag tu 'thib pa rnams// dgra bdag gshis ngan rang nyid gzhom pa'i phyir// g.yang du len pa'i go cha bgo par bya// 'jig rten dag na shin tu mi mkho ba'i// las dang nyon mongs sgyu ma 'khrugs pa rnams// bdag tu 'dzin pa'i srog dang dbral ba'i phyir// dang du len pa'i go cha bgo bar bya// phaṭa ya ho yi 'chi bdag mā ra ya// skyid 'dod 'gong po'i srog la dzwa la raṃ// snyoms las le lo'i mgo la chems se chem// 'khor ba'i sbrel thag rbad rbad chod par mdzod// bdag cag 'khor ba 'di ru sdug bsngal bas// 'di yi lan rtsa rdo rus gtugs pa na// rnam rtog snying gi gzhal yas ya ki na// nga'o zhes pa'i rgyal po bzhugs pa mthong*// de la le len bdas shing 'thab pa na// ci zer nga ni thog med dus nas zhugs// phyi nang bar gsum yongs su bdag gis khyab// bden rdzun tshogs drug gtso bo yongs la dris// bdag nyid bdag gi dgra yin su la 'thab// bdag nyid mgon yin thams cad su la skyob// bya dang mi bya yongs la dbang po rang*// rang gis rang nyid thul na grol bar 'gyur// gzhan gyis gzhan zhig 'dul na 'thab rtsod 'gyur// 'thab cing rtsod pa'i rlung na sdig can mtshar// des te chags sdang can la gral skabs med// des na rtog pa med pa'i rnal 'byor bde// a la de skad bya ba ci la zer// yod par 'dzin pa'i srog la mā ra ya// med par 'dzin pa'i srog la dzwa la raṃ// bdag 'dzin rgyal pos lan na gtso bo choms// gtso bo yid kyi rnam shes ma thul na// bdag 'dzin rgyal pos 'gab la khrid nyen yod// gtso bo yid kyi rnam shes thul ba na// mig sogs gtso bo (72)gzhan yang brlag par 'gyur// des na yid kyi rnam shes 'di thul dang*// gzugs sgra dri ro la sogs yod ma mchis// bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pa yod mi 'gyur// rnam rtog rgyal po rkyen dang bral bar mchi// de ltar rgyal po de la smras pa na// rnam rtog rang grol chos kyi dbyings su go

/tshogs drug mi bden sgyu ma'i glang po 'dra// gzung 'dzin mi bden sprul pa'i phrin las 'dra// de la sogs pa'i rnam rtog drung nas phyung*// gzung 'dzin med pa bdag lta dbyings su bsgyur// nga khyod med pas chags sdang gnyug mar zhog /ri bong rwa ltar rno brtul mi mnga' ba'i// dbang po rab 'bring 'chi ba'i srog dang phrol// mo gsham bu ltar dpyad gleng mi mnga' ba'i// 'khor 'das thams cad mnyam nyid gcig tu dril// rus sbal spu ltar ring thung mi mnga' ba'i// skye 'jig thams cad dbu ma chen por slod// brag cha lta bur ye nas stong pa yi// tha snyad chos rnams dam pa gcig tu dril// a a skye med nam mkha' lta bu'i dang*// i i 'jigs med spros pa bral ba'i sku// oṃ oṃ sna tshogs rnam dag chos skur ngo 'phrod nas// kā ru ṇi kas thugs rjes 'dzin par shog /'di ltar btsan dug nags su rma bya rgyu ba zhes bya ba/ shes bya rab 'byams la blo gros kyi mig byang nas las rgyu 'bras la bslu ba med pa'i mthu stobs thob kyang lta ba gnyis su med pa'i don la the tshom med par gyur pa ri nag po'i khong na gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pa dharma rakṣi ta zhes pa bdag gis sems can la dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje chen pos kun nas bslangs nas sbyar ba dge legs su gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ//
